title: Dead-code health handler in server.rs
evidence: src/server.rs:44 defines health() and HealthResponse, but routes.rs:271 defines and wires its own health(); the server.rs one is never routed
suggestion: Remove the unused server.rs health()/HealthResponse or route it, to avoid two divergent health handlers

title: update_book uses a 15-branch if/else field-permutation ladder
evidence: src/routes.rs:96-248 enumerates every combination of the four optional fields into separate UPDATE statements
suggestion: Use COALESCE(?, column) or a query builder to collapse the ladder into one statement

title: Validation stricter than spec: isbn and non-negative year required on create
evidence: src/models.rs:36-41 rejects empty isbn and year<0; TASK.md only requires title and author
suggestion: None needed — stricter than spec is acceptable; noted for cross-run comparison
